programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgementâ€
programme.desc: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shakes the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha
programme.desc: Inspector Malik transfers to Mumbai along with his family and sets out on a mission to catch King, an underworld leader. However, a shocking revelation changes the course of their lives.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Mr. Natwarlal
programme.desc: When Natwar's elder brother is framed for bribery, he decides to avenge his brother's humiliation and thus poses as a crime lord.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: A street urchin is caught up in a scheming grand vizier's plot to get his clutches on a magical lamp. Retrieving the object from a wondrous cave, he releases a powerful genie trapped inside, whose ability to grant wishes helps the young hero thwart the villain's plans and woo a princess. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: The Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Overworked estate agent Jim Evers takes his beleaguered family to look round an isolated, crumbling mansion - but the resident ghosts are not especially pleased to see the visitors. Comedy based on the Disney theme-park ride, starring Eddie Murphy, Terence Stamp, Jennifer Tilly and Marsha Thomason.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: Aliens Vs Predator - Requiem
programme.desc: A spaceship crash results in the infestation of a small town by aliens, so a Predator is despatched to hunt them down - and any superfluous humans who happen to get in the way. However, an even bigger threat is lurking in the area, in the form of a terrifying hybrid of the two extraterrestrial creatures. Sci-fi action sequel, starring Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth and John Ortiz.

programme.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
programme.desc: Amid emerging demand for hyperfuel and other resources, a headstrong pilot gets mixed up with a bunch of mercenaries, a militant robot, a gambler and a Wookie while attempting to appease a crime lord in an adventure that exposes an underworld's seedy belly. Sci-fi prequel set before the events of Star Wars: A New Hope, starring Alden Ehrenreich, Emilia Clarke, Woody Harrelson, Donald Glover and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: The Fault in Our Stars
programme.desc: Indianapolis teenager Hazel has terminal thyroid cancer and attends a patients' support group, where she meets fellow teen Gus, who lost a leg to the disease. The two fall in love and a shared passion for books leads them on a literary pilgrimage to Amsterdam in search of reclusive author Peter van Houten. Romantic drama based on the bestselling novel by John Green, starring Shailene Woodley, Ansel Elgort, Laura Dern and Willem Dafoe.

programme.title: Pocahontas
programme.desc: A Native American princess falls in love with an English settler, but her father is distrustful of the Europeans - not without just cause, as a cruel governor is prepared to wage war to get his hands on the gold he believes they are hiding. Animated drama, with the voices of Irene Bedard, Mel Gibson and Christian Bale.

Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso.

Thriller, starring Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean and Greta Scacchi.

When another new arrival brings an ominous message, he realises time is running out for the group and they must find an escape route through a deadly labyrinth if they are to survive. Sci-fi adventure based on James Dashner's novel, starring Dylan O'Brien, Kaya Scodelario and Patricia Clarkson.

programme.title: Love Speaks Through St Patrick
programme.desc: God may just be speaking to you as you sleep at night - we hear from modern leaders about how dreams can be either literal or symbolic, then go back to the unique story of Saint Patrick in Ireland.

programme.title: GOD TV Behind Bars
programme.desc: GOD TV is dedicated to sharing the Good News all around the world - Including those Incarcerated. Join us to see the impact of prison ministry, and how you can stand with us in this outreach.

programme.title: Order My Steps
programme.desc: Bishop John Francis of Ruach City Church helps 'Order Your Steps' with this encouraging series of messages for life and restoration. He preaches the Word of God and people's lives are changed.

programme.title: Portions Podcast
programme.desc: Join Jonathan Bernis and a host of guests on the Portions Podcast to journey through Scripture from a Jewish perspective and meet God along the way.

programme.title: Rick Renner
programme.desc: Rick Renner uses in-depth, engaging Bible teaching with his unique ability to draw vividly descriptive word pictures from Greek text, to help listeners gain new insight from God's Word.

programme.title: Rev It Up with Dr Sam
programme.desc: Beacon of Heart's mission is to proclaim Christ's salvation to all nations and peoples, starting locally and going globally. Our calling is to Revive souls, Restore the weary, and Return hearts to God

programme.title: CBN Studio 5
programme.desc: Studio 5 explores the intersection of celebrity, popular culture and faith, with an inside look at movies, music, sports and TV, through interviews with artists from around the entertainment industry.

programme.title: Glorious Moments - Prophet Jerome
programme.desc: Bishop H.E Rt. Rev Prophet Dr. Jerome Fernando answered the call of God over his life at a young age, and since then has had a heart to draw people to their rightful destinies in the Lord.

programme.title: Mark Chironna
programme.desc: Dr Mark Chironna of Church on the Living Edge presents this new half hour programme diving into the Word of God, bringing wisdom accrued from decades of Ministry to viewers.

programme.title: Oxford Bible Church - Derek Walker
programme.desc: Led by Derek and Hilary Walker, OBC aims to bring love, hope and healing to the world by teaching God's Word in the power of the Holy Spirit. Derek is an Oxford graduate, author and End-Time expert.

programme.title: Love Israel - Dr Baruch Korman
programme.desc: Known on Israeli TV for his messages in Hebrew, Dr Baruch Korman of the Zera Avraham Institute now presents biblically-based teachings on GOD TV with an emphasis on the Jewish context of scripture.

programme.title: CBN Christian World News
programme.desc: A biblical perspective to today's news and headlines.

programme.title: Jerusalem Dateline
programme.desc: CBN News Middle East bureau chief Chris Mitchell reports on the latest events and how they impact Israel and the stability of the Middle East.

programme.title: Through the Bible - Andrew Wommack
programme.desc: In this verse-by-verse journey from Genesis to Revelation, Andrew goes deep, unpacking Scripture line by line and helping you build a solid foundation in the Word for everyday life and discipleship.

programme.title: GOD TV Today
programme.desc: GOD TV Together offers daily encouragement and hope in your walk with the Lord. Be inspired and equipped as the team and their guests bring you insight, wisdom and testimonies of the Goodness of God.

programme.title: Turning Point - David Jeremiah
programme.desc: Dr David Jeremiah of Turning Point Broadcast Ministries and Shadow Mountain Church has a passion for people and a clear mission: Delivering the unchanging Word of God to an ever-changing world.

programme.title: Creflo Dollar
programme.desc: Dr. Creflo Dollar ministers to all walks of life with hope for change. With a renewal of faith, mind, and spirit, He and his wife Taffi share their vision for all to understand God's love and promises

programme.title: Believer's Walk of Faith
programme.desc: Bill Winston of Living Word Christian Centre invites viewers to go deeper on their faith journey. His ministry is a solution-seeking outreach that embraces the Bible as the basis of existence.

programme.title: Gospel Truth - Andrew Wommack
programme.desc: Teaching on God's unconditional love and grace from the founder of Andrew Wommack Ministries and Charis Bible College in Colorado.

programme.title: Enjoying Everyday Life
programme.desc: Are you searching for your purpose? Join Joyce, Ginger, Erin, and special guest Chris Caine as they talk about living with purpose, letting go of limitations, and taking your next step forward.

programme.title: Joseph Prince

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Norway v SenegalNorway v Senegal (Kick-off 1.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the second match in Group I for both teams, held at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. Norway were in outstanding form in qualifying, winning all eight of their matches to top a group containing the likes of Italy and Israel, with Manchester City star Erling Haaland scoring an incredible 16 goals. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Jordan v AlgeriaJordan v Algeria (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group J match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in the USA, as the two teams meet for just the fourth time, and a first in 22 years. Jordan finished second in AFC third-round qualifying Group B behind South Korea to reach their first-ever World Cup. Four victories and four draws in 10 games were enough to earn 16 points and finish one point clear of Iraq to avoid going into the fourth round of qualifying and confirm their place at these finals. Algeria reached their fifth World Cup finals with more ease after finishing top of their qualifying group, ending up seven points clear of nearest competitors Uganda. They won eight of their 10 games, losing only once, to Guinea in a surprise 2-1 defeat all the way back in June 2024. Despite that setback in the third round of group fixtures, they went on to score 24 goals and concede just eight as they made it to the finals for the first time since 2014. At that event they finished second in their group behind Belgium on four points before losing 2-1 to Germany in the last 16. Both these sides lost their opening game of the tournament on Tuesday, with Jordan losing 3-1 to Austria and Algeria tasting defeat in a 3-0 loss against Argentina. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Norway v SenegalNorway v Senegal (Kick-off 1.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the second match in Group I for both teams, held at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. Norway were in outstanding form in qualifying, winning all eight of their matches to top a group containing the likes of Italy and Israel, with Manchester City star Erling Haaland scoring an incredible 16 goals. However, they face a tough test against the Senegalese, who reached the last 16 in 2022, losing out to England in a 3-0 defeat. With analysis from Patrick Vieira and Juan Mata, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Jordan v AlgeriaJordan v Algeria (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group J match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in the USA, as the two teams meet for just the fourth time, and a first in 22 years. Jordan finished second in AFC third-round qualifying Group B behind South Korea to reach their first-ever World Cup. Four victories and four draws in 10 games were enough to earn 16 points and finish one point clear of Iraq to avoid going into the fourth round of qualifying and confirm their place at these finals. Algeria reached their fifth World Cup finals with more ease after finishing top of their qualifying group, ending up seven points clear of nearest competitors Uganda. They won eight of their 10 games, losing only once, to Guinea in a surprise 2-1 defeat all the way back in June 2024. Despite that setback in the third round of group fixtures, they went on to score 24 goals and concede just eight as they made it to the finals for the first time since 2014. At that event they finished second in their group behind Belgium on four points before losing 2-1 to Germany in the last 16. Both these sides lost their opening game of the tournament on Tuesday, with Jordan losing 3-1 to Austria and Algeria tasting defeat in a 3-0 loss against Argentina. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E24 — Portugal v UzbekistanPortugal v Uzbekistan (Kick-off 6.00pm). All the action from the second match in Group K for both sides, held at Houston Stadium in the USA. Portugal topped a group containing South Korea, Uruguay and Ghana four years ago in Qatar and then thrashed Switzerland 6-1 in the last 16. However, their tournament came to a halt in the quarter-finals when they were beaten 1-0 by Morocco. While that result was something of an upset, it would be an even bigger shock should they lose this evening against a team who are playing in their first World Cup finals as an independent nation and have very little experience of facing European outfits. Both of these teams got off to disappointing starts in their opening group games on Wednesday as Portugal were held to a 1-1 draw by DR Congo, while Uzbekistan were beaten 3-1 by Colombia.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E25 — Colombia v DR CongoColombia v DR Congo (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' second match in Group K, held at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Colombians have reached the knockout stage on three of the six occasions they have qualified for the finals, including their most recent appearance in 2018. Having faced Uzbekistan in their opening group contest, they will be looking to secure a place in the last 32 here before a final-game showdown with Portugal. However, they can take nothing for granted against the talented African outfit who are looking to make an impact in their first finals since 1974, when the country was known as Zaire. Colombia made a good start to their campaign on Wednesday with a 3-1 victory against Uzbekistan, while DR Congo played out an impressive 1-1 draw against Portugal. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Norway v SenegalNorway v Senegal (Kick-off 1.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the second match in Group I for both teams, held at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. Norway were in outstanding form in qualifying, winning all eight of their matches to top a group containing the likes of Italy and Israel, with Manchester City star Erling Haaland scoring an incredible 16 goals. However, they face a tough test against the Senegalese, who reached the last 16 in 2022, losing out to England in a 3-0 defeat. With analysis from Patrick Vieira and Juan Mata, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Jordan v AlgeriaJordan v Algeria (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group J match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in the USA, as the two teams meet for just the fourth time, and a first in 22 years. Jordan finished second in AFC third-round qualifying Group B behind South Korea to reach their first-ever World Cup. Four victories and four draws in 10 games were enough to earn 16 points and finish one point clear of Iraq to avoid going into the fourth round of qualifying and confirm their place at these finals. Algeria reached their fifth World Cup finals with more ease after finishing top of their qualifying group, ending up seven points clear of nearest competitors Uganda. They won eight of their 10 games, losing only once, to Guinea in a surprise 2-1 defeat all the way back in June 2024. Despite that setback in the third round of group fixtures, they went on to score 24 goals and concede just eight as they made it to the finals for the first time since 2014. At that event they finished second in their group behind Belgium on four points before losing 2-1 to Germany in the last 16. Both these sides lost their opening game of the tournament on Tuesday, with Jordan losing 3-1 to Austria and Algeria tasting defeat in a 3-0 loss against Argentina. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

This time around, both teams look all but certain to advance to the last 32 after each taking four points from their matches against Bosnia and Herzegovina and Qatar, with the co-hosts just needing a draw to guarantee top spot due to their superior goal difference.

programme.title: The Assembly

With commentary by David Addison and Tim Harvey.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Norway v SenegalNorway v Senegal (Kick-off 1.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the second match in Group I for both teams, held at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. Norway were in outstanding form in qualifying, winning all eight of their matches to top a group containing the likes of Italy and Israel, with Manchester City star Erling Haaland scoring an incredible 16 goals. However, they face a tough test against the Senegalese, who reached the last 16 in 2022, losing out to England in a 3-0 defeat. With analysis from Patrick Vieira and Juan Mata, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Jordan v AlgeriaJordan v Algeria (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group J match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in the USA, as the two teams meet for just the fourth time, and a first in 22 years. Jordan finished second in AFC third-round qualifying Group B behind South Korea to reach their first-ever World Cup. Four victories and four draws in 10 games were enough to earn 16 points and finish one point clear of Iraq to avoid going into the fourth round of qualifying and confirm their place at these finals. Algeria reached their fifth World Cup finals with more ease after finishing top of their qualifying group, ending up seven points clear of nearest competitors Uganda. They won eight of their 10 games, losing only once, to Guinea in a surprise 2-1 defeat all the way back in June 2024. Despite that setback in the third round of group fixtures, they went on to score 24 goals and concede just eight as they made it to the finals for the first time since 2014. At that event they finished second in their group behind Belgium on four points before losing 2-1 to Germany in the last 16. Both these sides lost their opening game of the tournament on Tuesday, with Jordan losing 3-1 to Austria and Algeria tasting defeat in a 3-0 loss against Argentina. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E24 — Portugal v UzbekistanPortugal v Uzbekistan (Kick-off 6.00pm). All the action from the second match in Group K for both sides, held at Houston Stadium in the USA. Portugal topped a group containing South Korea, Uruguay and Ghana four years ago in Qatar and then thrashed Switzerland 6-1 in the last 16. However, their tournament came to a halt in the quarter-finals when they were beaten 1-0 by Morocco. While that result was something of an upset, it would be an even bigger shock should they lose this evening against a team who are playing in their first World Cup finals as an independent nation and have very little experience of facing European outfits. Both of these teams got off to disappointing starts in their opening group games on Wednesday as Portugal were held to a 1-1 draw by DR Congo, while Uzbekistan were beaten 3-1 by Colombia.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E25 — Colombia v DR CongoColombia v DR Congo (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' second match in Group K, held at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Colombians have reached the knockout stage on three of the six occasions they have qualified for the finals, including their most recent appearance in 2018. Having faced Uzbekistan in their opening group contest, they will be looking to secure a place in the last 32 here before a final-game showdown with Portugal. However, they can take nothing for granted against the talented African outfit who are looking to make an impact in their first finals since 1974, when the country was known as Zaire. Colombia made a good start to their campaign on Wednesday with a 3-1 victory against Uzbekistan, while DR Congo played out an impressive 1-1 draw against Portugal. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Norway v SenegalNorway v Senegal (Kick-off 1.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the second match in Group I for both teams, held at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. Norway were in outstanding form in qualifying, winning all eight of their matches to top a group containing the likes of Italy and Israel, with Manchester City star Erling Haaland scoring an incredible 16 goals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira and Juan Mata, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Jordan v AlgeriaJordan v Algeria (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group J match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in the USA, as the two teams meet for just the fourth time, and a first in 22 years. Jordan finished second in AFC third-round qualifying Group B behind South Korea to reach their first-ever World Cup. Four victories and four draws in 10 games were enough to earn 16 points and finish one point clear of Iraq to avoid going into the fourth round of qualifying and confirm their place at these finals. Algeria reached their fifth World Cup finals with more ease after finishing top of their qualifying group, ending up seven points clear of nearest competitors Uganda. They won eight of their 10 games, losing only once, to Guinea in a surprise 2-1 defeat all the way back in June 2024. Despite that setback in the third round of group fixtures, they went on to score 24 goals and concede just eight as they made it to the finals for the first time since 2014. At that event they finished second in their group behind Belgium on four points before losing 2-1 to Germany in the last 16. Both these sides lost their opening game of the tournament on Tuesday, with Jordan losing 3-1 to Austria and Algeria tasting defeat in a 3-0 loss against Argentina. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E24 — Portugal v UzbekistanPortugal v Uzbekistan (Kick-off 6.00pm). All the action from the second match in Group K for both sides, held at Houston Stadium in the USA. Portugal topped a group containing South Korea, Uruguay and Ghana four years ago in Qatar and then thrashed Switzerland 6-1 in the last 16. However, their tournament came to a halt in the quarter-finals when they were beaten 1-0 by Morocco. While that result was something of an upset, it would be an even bigger shock should they lose this evening against a team who are playing in their first World Cup finals as an independent nation and have very little experience of facing European outfits. Both of these teams got off to disappointing starts in their opening group games on Wednesday as Portugal were held to a 1-1 draw by DR Congo, while Uzbekistan were beaten 3-1 by Colombia.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Norway v SenegalNorway v Senegal (Kick-off 1.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the second match in Group I for both teams, held at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. Norway were in outstanding form in qualifying, winning all eight of their matches to top a group containing the likes of Italy and Israel, with Manchester City star Erling Haaland scoring an incredible 16 goals. However, they face a tough test against the Senegalese, who reached the last 16 in 2022, losing out to England in a 3-0 defeat. With analysis from Patrick Vieira and Juan Mata, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Jordan v AlgeriaJordan v Algeria (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group J match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in the USA, as the two teams meet for just the fourth time, and a first in 22 years. Jordan finished second in AFC third-round qualifying Group B behind South Korea to reach their first-ever World Cup. Four victories and four draws in 10 games were enough to earn 16 points and finish one point clear of Iraq to avoid going into the fourth round of qualifying and confirm their place at these finals. Algeria reached their fifth World Cup finals with more ease after finishing top of their qualifying group, ending up seven points clear of nearest competitors Uganda. They won eight of their 10 games, losing only once, to Guinea in a surprise 2-1 defeat all the way back in June 2024. Despite that setback in the third round of group fixtures, they went on to score 24 goals and concede just eight as they made it to the finals for the first time since 2014. At that event they finished second in their group behind Belgium on four points before losing 2-1 to Germany in the last 16. Both these sides lost their opening game of the tournament on Tuesday, with Jordan losing 3-1 to Austria and Algeria tasting defeat in a 3-0 loss against Argentina. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026
programme.desc: S5 E24 — Portugal v UzbekistanPortugal v Uzbekistan (Kick-off 6.00pm). All the action from the second match in Group K for both sides, held at Houston Stadium in the USA. Portugal topped a group containing South Korea, Uruguay and Ghana four years ago in Qatar and then thrashed Switzerland 6-1 in the last 16. However, their tournament came to a halt in the quarter-finals when they were beaten 1-0 by Morocco. While that result was something of an upset, it would be an even bigger shock should they lose this evening against a team who are playing in their first World Cup finals as an independent nation and have very little experience of facing European outfits. Both of these teams got off to disappointing starts in their opening group games on Wednesday as Portugal were held to a 1-1 draw by DR Congo, while Uzbekistan were beaten 3-1 by Colombia.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E25 — Colombia v DR CongoColombia v DR Congo (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' second match in Group K, held at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Colombians have reached the knockout stage on three of the six occasions they have qualified for the finals, including their most recent appearance in 2018. Having faced Uzbekistan in their opening group contest, they will be looking to secure a place in the last 32 here before a final-game showdown with Portugal. However, they can take nothing for granted against the talented African outfit who are looking to make an impact in their first finals since 1974, when the country was known as Zaire. Colombia made a good start to their campaign on Wednesday with a 3-1 victory against Uzbekistan, while DR Congo played out an impressive 1-1 draw against Portugal. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Norway v SenegalNorway v Senegal (Kick-off 1.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the second match in Group I for both teams, held at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA. Norway were in outstanding form in qualifying, winning all eight of their matches to top a group containing the likes of Italy and Israel, with Manchester City star Erling Haaland scoring an incredible 16 goals. However, they face a tough test against the Senegalese, who reached the last 16 in 2022, losing out to England in a 3-0 defeat. The African side lost their opening match of this year's tournament thanks to a 3-1 defeat to France, while Norway got off to a perfect start after they hammered Iraq 4-1 as Erling Haaland scored a first-half brace. With analysis from Patrick Vieira and Juan Mata, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Jordan v AlgeriaJordan v Algeria (Kick-off 4.00am). Semra Hunter presents coverage of the Group J match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in the USA, as the two teams meet for just the fourth time, and a first in 22 years. Jordan finished second in AFC third-round qualifying Group B behind South Korea to reach their first-ever World Cup. Four victories and four draws in 10 games were enough to earn 16 points and finish one point clear of Iraq to avoid going into the fourth round of qualifying and confirm their place at these finals. Algeria reached their fifth World Cup finals with more ease after finishing top of their qualifying group, ending up seven points clear of nearest competitors Uganda. They won eight of their 10 games, losing only once, to Guinea in a surprise 2-1 defeat all the way back in June 2024. Despite that setback in the third round of group fixtures, they went on to score 24 goals and concede just eight as they made it to the finals for the first time since 2014. At that event they finished second in their group behind Belgium on four points before losing 2-1 to Germany in the last 16. Both these sides lost their opening game of the tournament on Tuesday, with Jordan losing 3-1 to Austria and Algeria tasting defeat in a 3-0 loss against Argentina. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.desc: S5 E24 — Portugal v UzbekistanPortugal v Uzbekistan (Kick-off 6.00pm). All the action from the second match in Group K for both sides, held at Houston Stadium in the USA. Portugal topped a group containing South Korea, Uruguay and Ghana four years ago in Qatar and then thrashed Switzerland 6-1 in the last 16. However, their tournament came to a halt in the quarter-finals when they were beaten 1-0 by Morocco. While that result was something of an upset, it would be an even bigger shock should they lose this evening against a team who are playing in their first World Cup finals as an independent nation and have very little experience of facing European outfits. Both of these teams got off to disappointing starts in their opening group games on Wednesday as Portugal were held to a 1-1 draw by DR Congo, while Uzbekistan were beaten 3-1 by Colombia.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E25 — Colombia v DR CongoColombia v DR Congo (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' second match in Group K, held at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Colombians have reached the knockout stage on three of the six occasions they have qualified for the finals, including their most recent appearance in 2018. Having faced Uzbekistan in their opening group contest, they will be looking to secure a place in the last 32 here before a final-game showdown with Portugal. However, they can take nothing for granted against the talented African outfit who are looking to make an impact in their first finals since 1974, when the country was known as Zaire. Colombia made a good start to their campaign on Wednesday with a 3-1 victory against Uzbekistan, while DR Congo played out an impressive 1-1 draw against Portugal. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: Holiday Love Rats Exposed
programme.desc: First of a three-part documentary series about people who have been conned out of money and left broken-hearted by someone they met on holiday.

programme.title: Holiday Love Rats Exposed
programme.desc: Three British women and an American describe how they met their husbands while they were abroad on holiday. One discovered that her husband was planning to leave her three years into their marriage after she had paid for his visa, while another reports that her ex-husband has asked her to look after his daughter from another marriage.

programme.title: Holiday Love Rats Exposed
programme.desc: Tracy, 54, travels to Turkey on a mission to get her money back from ex-lover Bulent, who has not paid back a business loan, and 51-year-old Anne Marie has over £14,000 of debt after being bamboozled by `Billy'.

programme.title: The Phantom of Soho
programme.desc: 1964. Director: Franz Josef Gottlieb. Stars Dieter Borsche, Barbara Rutting And Hans Sohnker. Patton investigates a masked killer's string of murders of men in London's foggy Soho district. [S]

programme.title: Murders In...
programme.desc: Murders in Collioure - Meurtres à Collioure. 2015. Director: Bruno Garcia. Stars Stéphane Freiss And Héléna Noguerra. A young woman is found murdered echoing a local medieval legend of a witch. [S]

programme.title: Low Water
programme.desc: 1966. Directed by Tom Scott Robson. In North East England, we take a look at the lives of the men that make a living collecting coal washed-up on beaches from underground seams.

programme.title: Star Treatment Show
programme.desc: 1979 Southern Televisions version of 'Opportunity Knocks!' This week starring: Cannon And Ball. Young entertainers are given a chance to showcase their talent in their own production. (S1, E04)

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. Pop Goes The Easel. Classic crime series produced by Aaron Spelling and starring Anne Francis. A famous artist causes problems for Honey and Sam.

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: 1965. The Personal Touch. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Jim Bowie
programme.desc: Gone to Texas. 1957. Stars Scott Forbes, Rodolfo Hoyos Jr. And Douglas Kennedy. Jim visits the Mexican state of Texas, hoping to buy land, but he's arrested as a spy and sentenced to death. [S]

programme.title: The Girl In the Picture (1957)
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed by Don Chaffey. Starring Donald Houston, Patrick Holt and Junia Crawford. George Keefe's policeman brother was murdered four years ago and the killer is still on the loose. [S]

programme.title: The Big Trees
programme.desc: 1952. Western. Directed by Felix E. Feist. Stars Kirk Douglas, Eve Miller And Patrice Wymore. A timber baron sets his sights on California's redwood trees but faces conflict with a Quaker colony. [S]

programme.title: Once A Sinner
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. A lowly bank clerk marries a good time girl but she two-times him for her old crooked boyfriend (Sydney Tafler). Starring Jack Watling, Pat Kirkwood and Thora Hird. [S]

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout the end of June and beginning of July. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance: The Executioner
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Robert Florey. Stars Charles Boyer, Berry Kroeger And Christopher Dark. A complex web of deception overshadows the investigation of the assassination of a police official. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Wounded Warder. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt, Charles Morgan And Bernard Bresslaw. A Warden is thrown from a landing at a prison. Sergeant Cork is called to investigate. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Bride. 1958. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard And Jennifer Jayne. Maddelenna is being forcibly taken to Altdorf Castle as a bride for Gessler. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Fairs Please
programme.desc: 1962. A film that looks at contemporary fairs, and explores their popularity, and diversity of entertainment.

programme.title: Small Hotel
programme.desc: 1957. Comedy. Director: David Mcdonald. Stars Gordon Harker, Marie Lohr, John Lode And Billie Whitelaw. At a small hotel, Albert, an aged but shrewd waiter, is a past master at the art of fiddling. [S]

programme.title: Clint Eastwood: The Last Legend
programme.desc: 2021. Documentary. Director: Clelia Cohen. A portrait of the last cowboy Hollywood Legend, Clint Eastwood. Dive into a 65-year career from 'The Good, The Bad and The Ugly', to 'Cry Macho' in 2021. [S]

programme.title: Live Now Pay Later
programme.desc: 1962. Drama. Directed by Jay Lewis. Stars Ian Hendry, June Ritchie And John Gregson. The adventures of a devious door to door salesman and his unscrupulous efforts to line his own pockets. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Flood Tide
programme.desc: 1964. A Look into the story of the ceaseless battle against the sea and shows how the Flood Warning System works.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: The Hunters. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Bettina Welch And Phillip Ross. A farmer is speared by Aboriginals for interrupting a sacred ceremony, Cobb and a tracker go in search of the wounded farmer. [S]

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Love Affair. 1968. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum And Leo G. Carroll. U.N.C.L.E investigates Brother Love, a religious figure who kidnaps leading scientists for a new Thrush operation. [S]

programme.title: The Mind of Mr. J. G. Reeder
programme.desc: 1971. The Willing Victim. Stars Hugh Burden, Willoughby Goddard, Gillian Lewis. The mild-mannered detective determines to find out who wants him dead after a bomb arrives in his office. [S]

programme.title: The Racing Game
programme.desc: Horsenap. 1979. Stars Mike Gwilym, Mick Ford And Iain Cuthbertson. A famous racehorse is kidnapped but no ransom demands are made. Sid and Chico are called on to find the horse and bring him home. [S]

programme.title: Horrors of the Black Museum

programme.desc: E1Albert Speer was Hitler’s favorite architect and a central figure within the Führer’s inner circle. Speer’s buildings helped cement Hitler’s position and push Germany towards war.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E2Wernher von Braun was instrumental to NASA’s Apollo 11 mission that put a man on the moon. His pioneering work in rocketry made it possible, but his past was kept under wraps.

programme.title: Secret Nazi Expeditions
programme.desc: E2Convinced the medieval witch trials were a Judeo-Christian attempt to exterminate the Aryans, Himmler established a special team led by Reinhard Heydrich to build a database of medieval German witchcraft practices.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E5In 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. Most Germans support Hitler's anti-Jewish policy and the regime's terror soon escalates.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E2Examining how warfare entered a new dimension as attacks from the skies became possible with weapons from incendiary arrows to drones.

programme.title: Secret Nazi Expeditions
programme.desc: E4A pseudoscientific theory embraced by the Nazis claimed that their Aryan ancestors had sought refuge in the Himalayas during a mythical cataclysmic ice age.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E7Historian Neil Faulkner tells the story of Lawrence of Arabia and his pioneering guerilla warfare against the railways of the Ottoman Empire.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E8This episode features tales of the heroism of the railway staff during the Blitz, and how a small siding in a Hampshire railway station played its part in the preparations for D-Day.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E1Ranged weapons guarantee a warrior's best chance of survival. International experts survey history’s most important ranged weapons, from the Roman spear and the English longbow, right up to the futuristic railgun.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E2Examining how warfare entered a new dimension as attacks from the skies became possible with weapons from incendiary arrows to drones.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E7In the shadow of the war, the Nazi regime gradually advances its "final solution to the Jewish problem", culminating in the Holocaust.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E8Along with Treblinka and Majdanek, Sobibor was one of the camps used in Operation Reinhard, in which the Nazis murdered almost two million people.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Hawker Hurricane was the first RAF aircraft to fly over 300mph. Over half of every enemy aeroplane destroyed in the Battle of Britain was by a Hurricane, not a Spitfire.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II. Regarded as one of the most important aircraft of the Cold War. It was a major part of the United States Air Force, Navy and Marine Corps, and was also used by many other countries.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E9Learn about life on a Tudor ship from objects found on the Mary Rose, while on HMS Victory discover the battle-winning tactics of Admiral Nelson.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E10In 1939, the German raider Atlantis was equipped with fake funnels and her sailors dressed as women pushing prams to fool Allied merchant ships. We also look at how merchant ships were painted with bizarre shapes to fool U-boats.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E3Weapons experts test the physical and psychological impact of close combat weapons - the Roman short sword, the medieval war hammer and the bayonet.
